risk_note: RV2 (commission, settlement). One judgement of a forfeited share (D10-481 ②, GATE-RESTORE-FORFEIT): the snapshot's initial_status as the start, then the latest beneficiary event by event_seq; only a latest forfeited counts, held does not. Commission's reads answer it (forfeitedEvents lists only shares whose latest event is forfeited; an initially forfeited share since lifted carries forfeitLifted, one extra SELECT only then), and clawback-order, credit-order, beneficiary-credit, pending-earnings-rules (and earnings through it) read that answer inside their existing locks; amount formulas, lock order and vouchers unchanged; the snapshot's initialStatus is not rewritten. D10-482: on restore, an identified minor's promotion share is not paid and gets forfeited(minor), no active event; self pays as usual; the minor check sits after the users row lock through BeneficiaryGate and the route fails closed without FIELD_CRYPTO. No migration, no contract change.
